rateTermsAfterExactRawCancellation.mode1: r times the matching normalized velocity scalar; all r^2, r_prime and mixed rate terms cancel.
rateTermsAfterExactRawCancellation.mode2: All explicit Gaussian rate terms cancel.

quotientInterpretation.primaryBodies: Each marked factor atom denotes its normalized value after removing one same-sign P; an inherited potential call uses the corresponding normalized potential body and the same formal partial.
quotientInterpretation.rawNativeJet: Leibniz terms express each differentiated Primary scalar divided by P before pullback. Evaluate those terms at H_w, including all normalized jet, gradient and pulse rate factors.
quotientInterpretation.pulledWrappers: Each wrapper in a projected polynomial is replaced by the corresponding normalized raw polynomial evaluated at H_w. All remaining factors are original projection coefficients.
quotientInterpretation.normalizedODE: Multiply native projected quotient by B_left at w. Mode 1 gives B_left times normalized projection. Mode 2 leaves one P(w) times that expression.
quotientInterpretation.nonlocalOperators: Initialized mean is kept whole as a degree-zero input. Shifted radial pressure/integral terms in its definition are neither dropped nor commuted through the Gaussian.

sourceStream.originalPrefixHashCoverage: node records only, without the new export header
